# PLDM attribution

This directory contains source files from [vladisai/PLDM](https://github.com/vladisai/PLDM), the implementation of
*Learning from Reward-Free Offline Data: A Case for Planning with Latent Dynamics Models*, at commit
[`1bd7e56`](https://github.com/vladisai/PLDM/tree/1bd7e564ecd961205bc18b23067b19e9ca24ac90).

- Upstream license: MIT ([LICENSE](LICENSE), copied unchanged; Copyright (c) 2025 Vlad Sobal).
- `pldm/models/encoders/resnet.py` keeps its Facebook, Inc. and affiliates copyright header, and `pldm/configs.py` its
  statement that `DataclassArgParser` is closely based on Hugging Face's `HfArgumentParser`.
- Local changes: line endings normalized from CRLF to LF ([UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md)); no other change.
